plainText:
Arrival at the Scientific Megalopolis (Japanese: 到着！！科学の巨大都市！ Arrival!! The Megalopolis of Science!) is the 28th chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
==Major events==
Zossie introduces and to the Ultra Megalopolis.
A arrives to battle .
Sun and Moon meet Soliera, another Ultra Recon Squad member.
Soliera forces Sun and Moon to battle Stakataka to prove their strength.
Lusamine receives a large amount of Beast Balls from disguised as Colress, which she aims to use to capture Necrozma.
